decisions.reason: The same-message INTRODUCE already represents the prize announcement and one-click claim instructions in reward_claim, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Winner announcement location and claim interaction do not change the method, eligibility, randomness, fairness, or verification of winner selection.
The claim workflow does not change which sales fund prize pools or how long funding continues.
The announcement and claim instructions do not change Big Block winner count, prize amount, draw trigger, or eligible population.
The announcement and claim instructions do not change Small Block winner count, prize amount, draw trigger, or eligible population.
The claim workflow does not alter ticket counters, eligibility windows, winning chances, or post-draw reset behavior.
Prize announcement and claiming do not change mint price or allocation of primary-mint revenue.
The claim workflow does not change the required flat secondary-sale royalty or its amount.
Prize announcement and claiming do not change referral badge conditions or milestone thresholds.
The prize claim instructions neither resume nor otherwise change the deferred Discord community server requirement.
Prize announcement and claiming do not change the Transak provider, supported payment methods, or wallet requirement for fiat minting.
The claim workflow does not change the optional confirmation email or its referral-code content.
